title: Quantum-safe IPsec in the banking industry
summary: The emergence of Cryptographically Relevant Quantum Computers (CRQCs) presents a critical threat to classical cryptographic systems, particularly widely adopted protocols such as RSA, Diffie-Hellman (DH), and Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC). Given their extensive use in the financial sector, the advent of quantum adversaries compels banking institutions to proactively develop and adopt quantum-safe communication mechanisms.
